title: Chocolate Delight: Holiday Edition
seo_title: Chocolate Delight: Holiday Edition on Nov 29, 2026
description: Chocolate Delight: Holiday Edition is an hour-long activity where you make your own candy bars while sipping your choice of drink. The summary describes it as an introduction to the art of confectionary, with a white chocolate bar among the creations. It takes place Sunday, November 29, 2026, from 1:00 PM to 2:00 PM at the Paint Studio in the Recreation Building.
